Customers include mid-sized and large enterprises in sectors like manufacturing, healthcare and finance. Founded in 2002, it has raised funding of about 418 million dollars, mostly from Battery Ventures and Summit Partners. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

CoinDCX is an Indian cryptocurrency exchange headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 2018. It offers an app and website for retail users to buy, sell and trade crypto, plus products such as futures and staking, and earns trading fees. It became India's first crypto unicorn in 2021 with backing from Coinbase Ventures and others, and has raised roughly $247 million in total. It has millions of registered users, runs heavy advertising in India, and has sponsored cricket-related campaigns. Strong consumer brand awareness in India.

In 2024 Microsoft hired Suleyman and much of the team, and Inflection licensed its models, now refocusing on enterprise AI. Limited current consumer visibility.

It acquired VITAC and Automatic Sync. Funding is about $569 million, with a valuation near $2 billion. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

It was valued at about $10 billion in a 2025 round, and funding shown is about $484 million. Customers include leading AI labs. B2B with rapidly rising profile in tech.

wiki.title: Simile
wiki.what: Figure of speech marked by explicit comparison
wiki.text: A simile is a type of figure of speech that directly compares two unrelated things, using wording to explicitly make the comparison. It is usually understood specifically to entail figurative comparison: thus "a wolf is like a dog" is merely a literal comparison, whereas the figurative "a man is like a wolf" is a simile. In the words of Michael Israel, Jennifer Riddle Harding, and Vera Tobin, "basically, a simile is just a way of describing a target by asserting its similarity to some unexpected entity".

wiki.title: Augustus
wiki.what: Roman emperor from 27 BC to AD 14
wiki.text: Augustus, also known as Octavian, was the founder of the Roman Empire and the first Roman emperor from 27 BC until his death in AD 14. The reign of Augustus initiated an imperial cult and an era of imperial peace when the Roman world was largely free of armed conflict. The principate, a style of government in which the emperor showed nominal deference to the Senate, was established during his reign and lasted until the Crisis of the Third Century.

wiki.title: Axiom
wiki.what: Statement that is taken to be true
wiki.text: An axiom, postulate, or assumption, is a statement that is taken to be true, to serve as a premise or starting point for further reasoning and arguments. The word comes from the Ancient Greek word ἀξίωμα (axíōma), meaning 'that which is thought worthy or fit' or 'that which commends itself as evident'.
